import fetcher
import requests_mock
from unittest.mock import Mock
import pytest

# Mock client to simulate requests.Session
class MockClient:
    def __init__(self):
        self.last_url = None
        self.last_timeout = None
        self.last_kwargs = None
    
    def get(self, url, timeout=None, **kwargs):
        self.last_url = url
        self.last_timeout = timeout
        self.last_kwargs = kwargs
        raise NotImplementedError("MockClient.get not implemented for this test")

def test_timeout_set():
    client = MockClient()
    with requests_mock.Mocker() as m:
        m.get("https://example.com")
        try:
            fetcher.fetch(client, "https://example.com")
        except Exception:
            pass  # Expected to raise an exception
        assert client.last_timeout == 30, "Timeout should be set to 30"

def test_args_preserved():
    client = MockClient()
    with requests_mock.Mocker() as m:
        m.get("https://example.com")
        try:
            fetcher.fetch(client, "https://example.com")
        except Exception:
            pass  # Expected to raise an exception
        assert client.last_kwargs == {}, "No additional kwargs should be added"

def test_exception_propagation():
    client = MockClient()
    client.get = Mock(side_effect=Exception("Test exception"))
    with pytest.raises(Exception, match="Test exception"):
        fetcher.fetch(client, "https://example.com")
